name: Reni Milchstrasse
original_name: レニ・ミルヒシュトラーセ
source: [Spoiler]As a young child in Germany, Reni was part of a program that created high spirit power children called "wunderkind".[/spoiler] Very composed and uncommunicative, Reni thinks only of the most effective way of disposing of enemy on battlefield.
translation: [Spoiler]As a young child in Germany, Reni was part of a program that created high spirit power children called "wunderkind".[/spoiler] Very composed and uncommunicative, Reni thinks only of the most effective way of disposing of enemy on battlefield.
